name: Mien luon
summary: Miến lươn on the 15 February 2023 Ninh Bình culture page is glass noodles in a broth simmered from eel bones, with eel cooked in seasoning. The page asks for small eels, brown-pink along the back.
origin: Ninh Bình. The culture page does not pin a street. Hanoi’s miến lươn is a different record.
howToEat: Eat it with banana flower cut in threads, as Sở Văn hóa và Thể thao describes.
where: Ninh Bình. A street was not printed. Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Mien luon in Ninh Binh — eel bone broth
seoDescription: Ninh Bình miến lươn is eel-bone broth and glass noodles with banana flower, from the 15 February 2023 culture page.
